title: release-provenance --post cannot tell a never-published version from one published without an attestation
description:
Found by the LCLI-625 reviewer (2026-09-28); recorded by the LCLI-625 implementer from the reviewer's report, with both cited sites re-read at the LCLI-625 branch head.

MECHANISM: readProvenance in scripts/release-provenance.mjs treats an HTTP 404 from npm's attestation endpoint as 'absent' ('registry has no attestations for this version'). npm answers the same way for a version that was never published at all, so --post cannot tell 'published, no attestation' from 'not published'.

WHERE IT BITES: release.yml's publish job publishes the six platform packages first and the X-rc.N launcher last (publish_or_skip "$root" after the platform loop). If that job dies before the launcher, provenance-post still runs (its if: is !cancelled() && needs.publish.result != 'skipped'). It then reports the rc launcher as unattested, with the LCLI-482 manual-publish explanation, which is wrong: the launcher was never published. And if any platform package of that release IS attested, the propagation window waits the full PROVENANCE_WAIT_SECONDS (180s) on a version that does not exist.

FIX: before reading attestations, check that the version exists on the registry (a packument or version read that distinguishes npm's not-found from an outage), and report 'not published' as its own outcome. It should not be folded into absent, should not get a propagation wait, and should carry text naming the partial publish rather than LCLI-482.

acceptanceCriteria.text: --post reports a package@version that is not on the registry as a distinct not-published outcome, never as absent, proven by a stub test in which the launcher X-rc.N was never published
A not-published package gets no propagation wait even when another package of the release is attested, proven by a bounded-time test
The not-published warning names a partial publish, not the LCLI-482 manual-publish cause, and a registry outage while checking existence is inconclusive rather than not-published
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change
